name: token-savings
description: Context-cost reduction for Claude and Codex, with the measurement instrument that decides whether the reduction is real. A PreToolUse guard routes selected read-only commands through rtk, scoped to an allowlist verified to preserve content, and a second denies reading a repomix pack (six context windows on a large repository) while naming the rg and awk that search it. Oversized shell output spills to a file with its recovery commands. The tokenmeter A/B harness measures runs from transcript usage records instead of a tool's self-report, and repomix-tune re-derives every pack-filtering claim on the installed repomix. Telemetry stays off. Requires python3 on PATH; rtk and repomix are optional and every path degrades to a no-op without them.
